target.title: test: cover Android notification forwarding callbacks
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android notification forwarding had coverage for preference parsing, rate limiting helpers, and the gateway-facing `notifications.*` commands, but not the listener callback path that turns real Android notification events into `notifications.changed` node events.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds Robolectric coverage around `DeviceNotificationListenerService.onNotificationPosted` and `onNotificationRemoved` using `StatusBarNotification` instances. The tests now exercise:

- posted notification payloads, trimmed text fields, category/channel metadata, and configured `sessionKey`
- self-package suppression and allowlist filtering before the node event sink is called
- quiet-hours suppression and burst limiting on the callback path
- removed notification events without forwarding stale notification content

## User Impact

Future Android changes are less likely to silently break notification forwarding or leak suppressed notifications into gateway-visible events.

## Evidence

- `git diff --check`
- `cd apps/android && ./gradlew :app:testThirdPartyDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.node.DeviceNotificationListenerServiceTest`
- `cd apps/android && ./gradlew :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.node.DeviceNotificationListenerServiceTest`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` -> clean, no accepted/actionable findings
